description: Native and USDC balances of an EVM wallet across Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism and Ethereum in one call, plus whether the address is a contract on each chain. $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.
